server_context.organization_tenant_id: derived from the authenticated server grant; never accepted from client, model, job, personal rule, or personal-brain input
server_context.sponsoring_human_id: derived from verified Joe or Dell grant metadata, or explicitly null for unsponsored work; never inferred from the agent principal
server_context.partner_id: canonical partner identity equal to the verified sponsor, or null
server_context.agent_principal_id: registered action actor derived from authenticated runtime identity
server_context.runtime_principal: authenticated runtime instance and credential class
server_context.session_capability_profile: server-issued independently of sponsor and personal rules; exact, unexpired, and non-transferable
server_context.personal_brain_scope: derived only from verified sponsoring_human_id; null for unsponsored work; foreign or caller-selected scope is denied
server_context.personal_brain_version_and_count: connector/store and generated render must agree for the same partner; missing or ambiguous scope returns identity_scope_unknown rather than successful zero
server_context.environment: derived from the typed route and server-authorized scope; never accepted as an authority claim
server_context.binding: all identity dimensions are immutable for the full request, response, event, audit, export, and safe-return chain
server_context.implementation_status: future server enforcement gate; absent from the Phase 0 prototype

rules: Schemas are strict and IDs and cursors are opaque.
Pagination uses stable snapshot and cursor semantics.
Environment is required on each operational object and never inferred.
Organization tenant is required on every operation and is derived by the server from the authenticated grant; no client-selected tenant is authoritative.

Human sponsor, agent principal, runtime principal, capability profile, and personal-brain scope are separate server-derived or server-validated dimensions; one cannot be inferred from or widened by another.
Joe-sponsored Codex or Claude resolves shared plus Joe-personal; Dell-sponsored resolves shared plus Dell-personal; unsponsored agents receive task-scoped rules only and never humanOnly capability.
Missing, ambiguous, cross-brain, or connector/render-mismatched personal scope is a visible failure or Unknown and never a successful zero-personal response.
Repository, event, audit, export, and model-context reads require an exact server-derived tenant and environment predicate.
Event replay contains server-stored redacted events only.
Reconnect reports continued server state and cannot imply browser ownership.
The browser session uses a distinct audience and cookie from Workspace, Deal Room, and MCP.
